11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager is so tired of making decisions all morning that even choosing lunch feels exhausting.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has spent the morning making decisions. Which crops need water? Which tools need repair? Who should gather the herbs? Where should the baskets go? By lunchtime (subject.he/she) is thoroughly tired of deciding things. Even choosing what to eat feels exhausting.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (friend) brings (subject) a bowl of fruit and fish. "I hope this is alright." (subject) looks delighted. "It's wonderful. I didn't have to choose any of it."

a__text.name: Answer A

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (subject) sits beneath a tree and watches the clouds. Nobody asks (subject.him/her) anything for almost an hour. It is the most restful part of the day. Eventually (subject) gets up and returns to work, feeling somewhat refreshed.
